description: This Java class implements business logic for applying overdue charges to loans within the account management workflow in the Apache Fineract project. It retrieves overdue installments for a given loan and applies applicable charges.

classes.name: ApplyChargeToOverdueLoansBusinessStep
classes.description: Business step class responsible for applying overdue charges to loans during the check-out process.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the business logic for applying overdue charges to the provided loan.

methods.description: Returns a string identifier for this business step.

methods.description: Returns a human-readable description of the business step.
